principles: Generated images contain no prices, subscription plan names, legal copy, CTA text, or restore text.
All commercial, localized, and legal text must be rendered by Flutter from store/server metadata.
Assets are app-owned for V1 and can later move behind a server-delivered paywall asset manifest.
